instruction: I ordered a robot vacuum on amazon on my brother's birthday last year. How much does it cost now, ignoring tax and delivery fees?
notes: Read-only information-gathering task: no database changes are allowed, so every action is a lookup. The brother's birthday is discovered via phone.search_contacts with relationship="brother"; the order placed on that date last year (2022) is found via amazon.show_orders (query "robot vacuum" narrows the list; the agent may also page through all orders), its product id via amazon.show_order, and the current price via amazon.show_product. Static init facts (birthday-of, order-placed-on, order-contains, product-price) encode world structure whose values are unknown until looked up; known-*/found-* predicates track discovered knowledge. supervisor-complete-task passes the price as the answer; the product parameter is a non-API record parameter tying the answer to the right product.
